name: The Operation of Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing
benefit:
1. The scheme provides financial incentives linked to incremental production and sales of manufactured goods in India, encouraging actual performance-based growth.
1. It promotes large-scale manufacturing investment in India, helping companies expand capacity and strengthen production facilities in targeted sectors.
1. The scheme helps in increasing domestic manufacturing output and value addition
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a company engaged in manufacturing under the specified target segments and must meet the defined qualification criteria for eligibility under the scheme. 1. The applicant should have a consolidated global manufacturing revenue in the relevant target segment exceeding the prescribed threshold in the base year, including revenue of group companies as applicable. 1. The applicant should satisfy the minimum eligibility thresholds of incremental investment and incremental sales of manufactured goods over the base year as specified in the scheme guidelines. 1. The applicant should ensure that eligibility for incentive in any year is subject to meeting the required threshold criteria for that particular year under the scheme. 1. The applicant should acknowledge that failure to meet the threshold criteria in any given year will result in non-eligibility for incentive for that year, without affecting eligibility in subsequent years. 1. The applicant should ensure that incremental sales of manufactured goods over the base year are considered for determining eligibility, irrespective of invoice value thresholds. 1. The applicant should comply with the condition that only sales of manufactured goods under the target segments are considered for evaluation of eligibility. 1. The applicant should understand that eligibility under this scheme shall not impact eligibility under any other scheme, and vice versa.
